title: fix(scenarios): a recorded replay re-sends each turn's recorded writes before the read-back
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoEDtPjXPciS3z2UwV39x6wK)_

Clause-②: yes (widening) — new export `ReplayNotFaithfulError` and new optional field `AskTask.callTool`, both reached through `./runner` (`src/runner/index.ts` re-exports `driver.ts`)
Metadata-protocol: none

Fixes #33737

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:录制重放(`--driver recorded:`)现在会把录制里每个回合的写入(新建/修改/删除/调用动作)按原顺序、以同一角色重新发给新启动的应用,再读回结果;读操作不重发。
- 为什么改:以前重放只回放模型的回答、不发写入,所以「应当成功」的操作在重放里一律读不到数据、判失败(haiku crm 实跑 3/5,重放 1/4),操作分无法重评。
- 风险与回滚:只影响重放驱动,实跑驱动不变;重放时若应用的回答与录制不同(被拒的码不同、成功变失败等),该题/操作记为「未测量」并写明是哪个调用,绝不判失败。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/driver.ts` 的 `RecordedDriver.ask`(重发与比对),`src/runner/orchestrate.ts` 的 `runHalf`(把应用的 MCP 门交给驱动、接住不一致)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`,应见 55 项全过,其中新的 eval#1 重放组 8 项。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `RecordedDriver.ask` re-sends the recorded turn's write calls (`create_record`, `update_record`, `delete_record`, `run_action`) to the booted app, in recorded order, through the new optional `AskTask.callTool` (the runner's own MCP door as the turn's persona), before it hands the turn back, so the runner's read-back finds what the recorded run wrote. Reads are never re-sent.
- A recorded refused write is re-sent too and must meet the same refusal (same code; a flow refusal stays a flow refusal; an uncoded error stays uncoded).
- A row the recorded run created gets a new id in the replayed app; a later recorded write naming the recorded id, in the same turn or a later one, is sent with the new id.
- The replay is not faithful, and the turn measures nothing (`ReplayNotFaithfulError`), when the app answers a re-sent write otherwise than the recorded run did, or when a recorded write has no recorded answer (the turn was cut short; nothing of that turn is re-sent). `runHalf` records the question or operation NOT MEASURED with the reason naming each call, keeps the recorded turn summary, and never grades it a fail.
- `runHalf` gives every question and operation turn the door (`callTool` bound to the persona's key through `AppHarness.callTool`). Live drivers ignore it; a caller that only re-reads a recording (no door) gets the turn back and nothing is sent.
- README: one sentence on the replay in the runner's Driver paragraph. Changeset `33737-replay-resends-recorded-writes.md` (patch).

## Measurement (read-only, before the change)

- Recordings: all 79 `*.rec.json` under the eval seat's runs (`/mnt/project-files/eval/runs/`, 2026-11-14/15): 533 recorded write calls, every one in an operation turn, every one with its recorded answer (0 without), 0 turns mixing answered and unanswered writes. Each call carries the tool name and its input, and the step key names the persona, so a faithful re-send is possible for every call. 2 writes name a row created earlier in the same turn (create then update), which the id remap covers.
- eval#1's reading reproduced on `main` `53f5a4c9`: haiku `crm_account_with_contacts` replay, Run-operations `1/4 · 1 not measured`; `add_contact` "0 row(s) read back", `move_eli` read "ac3", declared "ac1", audit actor "admin".
- Same recording on this branch (`5bdadc88`): Run-operations `3/4 · 1 not measured`, Iterate the same; `add_contact` and `move_eli` pass, as in the live run. `contact_bad_email` stays the existing build-denial NOT MEASURED, as on `main`. Build 27/27, 问数 8/9 unchanged.

## Tests

- New top-level describe in `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts` replaying the verbatim eval#1 turns (fixture `test/runner/fixtures/eval-haiku-crm-replay.recording.json`, four operation turns of the haiku crm recording, reads included) through `runHalf` against a fake MCP door that behaves as that build: `add_contact` reads its row back and passes, `move_eli` passes with its audit actor; the app receives exactly the recorded writes in order, each as its persona, and no read; a recorded refused delete and create are re-sent and refused again; an app that answers otherwise makes the operation NOT MEASURED naming the call, with no grade and no error. Driver-level: the created-id remap (same turn and later turn), the unanswered-write turn (nothing sent, not faithful), a door that throws, and a turn read without a door.
- The four eval-r1 build-denial replay tests now see the replay's re-sent writes beside the runner's probes; their fake app answers the re-sends as that build did, and their grades are unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- `move_eli` on `main` read the audit actor as "admin": the replay's app had only the seed's writes. With the re-send the audit actor is the persona again.
- A question turn's recorded writes are re-sent as well (the driver cannot tell a question from an operation, and re-sending keeps the app state later turns read the same as the live run's); the 79 recordings hold none.
- Two local replays of the branch scaffolded a project whose install did not complete (`npx objectstack` 404, "no project was installed"); the scaffold precedes every driver call, and the third run with `--work` on a fixed directory completed. Not investigated further; noted in case it recurs.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build`, `typecheck`, `test`: exit 0, Test Files 32 passed, Tests 790 passed (after the merge: typecheck + test exit 0, 790/790).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 62 derived families, all run, each exit 0 (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` after fetching its fixture commit; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` after `turbo run build --filter=./packages/**`); `--ran` reconciliation: 62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

</details>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the re-send guard in `RecordedDriver.ask` with an unconditional `return turn` (anchor 1 → 0, blob e66c5893 → 32a70041): `orchestrate.test.ts` went red, 10 failed (the 7 new replay tests that send, and 3 of the 4 build-denial tests). Restored by the tool; `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards.

</details>
